rows.body: The default export in this file was renamed from `HeaderWithBackButton` to `Header`, but the file is still named `HeaderWithBackButton.tsx`. Per `DIRECTORIES.md`, a file must be named after its primary/default export so it stays discoverable by its export name. Either keep the export named `HeaderWithBackButton`, or rename the file to `Header.tsx` to match the new export name (updating `export default Header;` on line 204 accordingly).

This file is named `index.ts` but it is a single-export implementation module whose primary export is the `useHeaderStyles` hook (not a re-export of platform variants). Per DIRECTORIES.md, non-platform-specific files must be named after what they export so the module is discoverable by its export name.

Rename the file to `useHeaderStyles.ts` and import it as `import useHeaderStyles from './styles/useHeaderStyles';`.

The file is named `useHydrateSnapshotReport.ts`, but its primary/default export is `useHydrateReportsFromSnapshot`. Per `DIRECTORIES.md`, non-platform files must be named after what they export so the module is discoverable and searchable by its export name. The mismatch here makes the hook harder to find.

Rename the file to match its export:
```
src/hooks/useHydrateReportsFromSnapshot.ts
```
and update the imports in `SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx` and `SearchTransactionsChangeReport.tsx` accordingly.

This new file is a single-export React component placed in a bare `index.tsx`, but it is not a platform-variant barrel (there are no `.ios`/`.android`/`.native`/`.web` siblings that it re-exports). Per the file-naming philosophy, non-platform modules should be named after what they export so the module is discoverable/searchable by its export name.

Rename the file to match its export, e.g. `src/pages/home/common/WidgetHeaderMenu/WidgetHeaderMenu.tsx`, and update the import in `RecentlyAddedSection/index.tsx` and `SpendOverTimeSectionContent.tsx` accordingly (the `@pages/home/common/WidgetHeaderMenu` folder import can still resolve via a small barrel only if platform variants are later added).

This new file is named `ApprovalWorkflowParams.ts` but its only (default) export is `SetApprovalWorkflowParams`. The file basename should match its primary export. Every sibling in `src/libs/API/parameters/` follows this convention exactly (e.g. `SetPolicyCodingRuleParams.ts` exports `SetPolicyCodingRuleParams`), so the mismatch breaks discoverability and consistency.

Rename the file to `SetApprovalWorkflowParams.ts` and update the re-export in `src/libs/API/parameters/index.ts`:

```ts
export type {default as SetApprovalWorkflowParams} from './SetApprovalWorkflowParams';
```
